## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Document Verification

### What is Authenticate.com’s document verification process?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Authenticate.com’s document verification process is an automated workflow that instantly confirms a person’s ID. Users simply upload a photo of their government ID and take a live selfie; our AI then verifies the document’s authenticity and performs a real-time selfie match to ensure the faces align. This automated document verification provides results in seconds for a secure, compliant onboarding experience. Get started in minutes with our streamlined verification.

### How do Authenticate.com’s identity verification services work?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Authenticate.com’s identity verification services combine document verification, biometric checks, and database screenings to quickly confirm each user’s identity. It’s an all-in-one solution that works across industries – from fintech startups to logistics firms and government agencies – helping you meet KYC/AML compliance requirements. The process is fast, secure, and user-friendly, so you can onboard customers with confidence.

### What is document verification and why is it important?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Document verification is the process of checking the authenticity of an ID, such as a passport or driver’s license, to confirm someone’s identity. It’s crucial for preventing fraud, complying with KYC regulations, and building trust during customer onboarding. Authenticate.com offers fast and secure document verification for businesses of all sizes.

### Can I automate the document verification process for my business?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Yes! With Authenticate’s document verification software, you can integrate seamless, real-time ID checks into your existing systems using our API or no-code workflows. This speeds up onboarding, reduces manual review, and helps you stay compliant with industry standards.

### Which document verification software is best for automated ID checks and identity document verification?

![Accordion Icon](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Authenticate.com offers industry-leading document verification software designed for fast, automated identity document verification. Our platform supports a wide range of ID document verification needs, from driver’s licenses to passports, with built-in AI document verification and live selfie matching. Whether you need a secure document verification API, scalable verification system, or easy-to-use dashboard, Authenticate helps you verify documents instantly and meet compliance across KYC, AML, and onboarding workflows.
